title: DeviceChain Location payload
description: The payload of a device event whose eventType is Location. Every entry is one position fix. Every field of an entry is a JSON string, including the numeric ones: a bare number fails the whole message. Each value must parse as a finite number inside its range, or the message is refused. One event may carry at most 256 entries.

entries.description: The fixes. A payload with no entries, or with coordinates placed directly under payload instead of in entries, is refused.

elevation.description: Metres above the WGS84 ellipsoid, not above mean sea level. Magnitude at most 99999999.

accuracy.description: Horizontal accuracy in metres, from 0 to 99999999.

heading.description: Degrees clockwise from true north, from 0 up to but not including 360. A value that would be stored as 360.0000 (359.99995 or more) is refused.

occurredTime.description: This fix's own instant, RFC 3339. Omitted, the fix takes the envelope's occurredTime. Refused under the same rules as the envelope's.
